Crop of the Players Committee card image [[:File:V1-L-r2d2-PC-E2.gif]] (before the change to [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Errata 4)]]): pixels 0–745 × 602–1039 of the 745×1039 image (coordinates scaled to the earlier image’s own size; pixels unchanged). Cropped only; no other edits.
